approval.note: ADS-070 requires the owners to approve the question definitions and the expected results independently. Neither has approved. Until both do, every report that uses this corpus says so.
approval.change_rule: Changing the corpus changes its digest; a new digest needs new owner approvals and must not be bundled with a change that regresses a gate.

limits: Written for the reference stack: one seeded table, one certified metric (revenue), two dimensions, and a scripted model that recognises these phrasings. It measures the governed pipeline, not language understanding.
Customer-style questions here are phrasings of the reference intents, not real customer questions; the data owner must supply real ones before a pilot decision.
